title: Add a new zh-CN + en-US i18n key for the budget meter
description: Add a new i18n key to the project's zh-CN and en-US dictionaries at `frontend/src/lib/i18n.ts`. The key namespace is `issue.side.budget*` (siblings of the existing `issue.side.budget`/`issue.side.budgetSpent`/... keys). Required new entries: `issue.side.budgetOf` with a `{budget}` interpolation parameter (zh-CN: `"/ {budget}"`, en-US: `"/ {budget}"`), and `issue.side.budgetRemaining` with a `{remaining}` interpolation parameter (zh-CN: `"剩余 {remaining}"`, en-US: `"{remaining} left"`). Both locales must register both keys with identical parameter names.
acceptance_criteria: issue.side.budgetOf exists in both zh-CN and en-US dictionaries
issue.side.budgetRemaining exists in both zh-CN and en-US dictionaries
Both keys accept the documented interpolation parameters

argv: from pathlib import Path; text = Path('frontend/src/lib/i18n.ts').read_text(); assert text.count('\"issue.side.budgetOf\":') == 2; assert text.count('\"issue.side.budgetRemaining\":') == 2
pinned_qa_commands.description: Both keys present in both locales (each grep count must be 2)
Frontend tests must still pass (i18n coverage test enforces parity)

notes: i18n coverage test in tests/ verifies key parity between locales; the second pinned command runs that test.
